title: Day Three of the Hiccups
subject: a man in Croydon who has had the hiccups for three days, working through every cure his coworkers swear by, sugar, a paper bag, drinking upside down, a sudden shout from behind, and none of them working
caption: Synthwave, retro 1980s outrun style. Pulsing analogue bass arpeggio, gated reverb drums with big snare, bright polysynth lead melody, clean electric guitar lead line in the solo. Glossy 80s production, wide stereo chorus, neon night atmosphere. Male tenor, clearly sung melody, strong 80s pop delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, E minor. Moody, deadpan, comic. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap, no dubstep, no acoustic guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - bass arpeggio, gated drums]

[Verse 1]
Monday at the meeting, I said hic
Tuesday on the train, I said hic
Every forty seconds, on the dot
Half a sentence is all I've got

[Pre-Chorus]
Janet says a spoon of sugar
Dev says hold your breath

[Chorus]
Day three of the hiccups
And the city's lit up blue
I drank my water upside down
And nothing's getting through

[Verse 2]
Brian jumped out shouting by the lifts
I spilt my coffee down his shirt
My mother rang and said to pinch my nose
Then laughed so hard she had to go

[Pre-Chorus]
I lay awake at three
Counting every one

[Chorus]
Day three of the hiccups
And the city's lit up blue
They stopped while I was sleeping
And I kind of miss them too

[Outro - synth lead, arpeggio fades]
Day four, silence, hic
